title: Subitising
examples: Can we practice with more dots?
How do I know how many dots are there?

explain.say: Look at these dots on the screen for you. Can you tell me how many you see right now?
You do not need to count them one by one for you. You just see the group of dots. This quick seeing is called subitising for you.
Next, we look at a dice pattern for you. If I show you two dots, you say two right away. You are using your quick number sense.
Now, let us look at a ten-frame pattern for you. If I fill in four dots, you instantly know the number is four. This helps us see patterns.

faq.a: Subitising means you can see a small group of items and know the total without counting. It is a quick number skill for you.
asks: How do I know how many dots are there?

faq.q: Do I have to count every time?
faq.a: No, the goal is to see the number right away in your head. Counting is what you do after you subitise for you.
asks: Can I just guess the number?
Is it okay if I count sometimes?

faq.q: How does the ten-frame help me?
faq.a: The ten-frame helps you see numbers up to ten in a clear box. It shows you where the numbers fit nicely.
asks: Why do we use the ten-frame?

faq.q: Can I use my fingers to help?
faq.a: Yes, using your fingers is a good way to help you practice seeing numbers. It makes the concept very clear for you.
asks: Is it okay to count on my fingers?

faq.q: Is this for big numbers only?
faq.a: No, we start with small numbers like five or less for you. This builds the foundation for bigger numbers later.
asks: Will I learn big numbers next?
Do I have to learn this for big numbers?

facts: Subitising is seeing a small group of items and knowing the total.
It is a quick way to know the number without counting each one.
Dice are often used to practice subitising for you.
The ten-frame helps you visualize numbers up to ten.

quiz.say: If you see three dots, what number do you say?
quiz.why: You see exactly three dots, so the number you say is three. The other numbers are wrong because they do not match the dots you see.

wrong.2: Two is wrong because there are three dots, not two.

quiz.say: If a dice shows five dots, what is the number?
quiz.why: You look at the five dots and say the number five right away. The other options are wrong because they do not match the dots shown on the dice.

wrong.0: Four is tempting, but you must count the dots you see, which is five.

quiz.say: If a ten-frame has four dots, what number is it?
quiz.why: You see four dots in the ten-frame, so the number is four. Ten is too many, and zero means no dots are there.

wrong.0: Ten is the total space, but you only have four dots filled in.
